name: Angela
source:
Role: Prior 
[Spoiler]O Lord, please grant me the strength to turn the other cheek. I do not like or trust this woman. She is from a convent in Italy; I wish she would go back there. I take a small amount of comfort knowing I'm not the only one who cannot stand her; Katherine in particular seems to despise her. I don't think she killed Catherine, but I know precious little about their relationship. I have to imagine it was as combative as ours.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
